title: Acid–base equilibria
summary: Brønsted–Lowry acids and bases and conjugate pairs; the autoionisation of water and pH; Ka, Kb and the strength of acids and bases; weak-acid and weak-base equilibrium calculations; salt hydrolysis, buffers and the Henderson–Hasselbalch relation; titration curves and indicators.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 20–24 of 5.111SC (Unit III) with OpenStax chapter 14.

preparation.description: OCW Unit III page: lectures 20 (solubility and acid–base equilibrium), 21 (is MIT water safe to drink?), 22 (salt solutions and buffers), 23–24 (titrations), each with notes, problems and solutions.
OpenStax 14.1 Brønsted-Lowry Acids and Bases, 14.2 pH and pOH, 14.3 Relative Strengths of Acids and Bases.
